name: vortex
title: Vortex
description: Turn around the centre and slip through the gaps as walls close in on the beat. Six stages, each with its own song, colours and tricks, and a hyper version of each; ranks every few seconds up to the minute that clears a stage, a daily run with the same walls for everyone, and a retry one key away.
author: pal

settings.label: Volume
settings.description: How loud the music and the sounds are; M in the game turns them off.

store.tagline: Slip through the closing walls, on the beat

actions.title: Turn
actions.description: Round the centre, either way; A and D too. Hold Shift to turn slowly for a fine line.

actions.title: Play, or play again
actions.description: After a death the next run is one key away.

actions.title: Choose a stage
actions.description: Left and right on the stages; up for a stage's hyper once you've cleared it.

features: Walls close in on the centre with one way through; turn to the gap before they reach you, while the world spins, reverses and changes shape
Six stages, Pulse to Singularity, each with its own song, colours, camera and patterns: spirals, tunnels you have to go all the way round, rails, mirrors and whirlwinds
Music made as you play, and the walls land on its beat; the song builds a layer at every rank
Ranks every few seconds, Point to Hexagon: a minute clears a stage, opens the next one and the stage's hyper, faster and in other colours
Every pattern is spaced for the turn it asks of you, so a death is always yours to fix; the next run is one key away
A daily run: the same walls for everyone all day, your best kept for the day

screenshots.caption: Pulse, 27 seconds in: past Triangle, a run of gaps to read while the world turns
Prism at Square: the centre changes shape between patterns and the colours never sit still
Undertow's steep camera and half-time song, the moment a record falls: the time turns gold
Singularity in hyper: the last stage, faster, in its other colours
A death: the walls roll back, and the card says how close the record and the next rank were; Space is the next run
The stages, each playing itself behind its card: your best, its rank and your tries

vortex.title: Vortex
vortex.description: Turn round the centre through the closing walls. Escape or closing the panel pauses a run.

keys.title: Turn (arrows or A and D; Shift turns slowly)
